chapters.title: Block and crankshaft
chapters.description: Complete each priority group, then continue to the next chapter.

chapters.title: Pistons and connecting rods
chapters.description: Bench-build piston, rod, wrist pin, circlips, studs and rings. Install the three complete units from the cylinder side; turn the block over, then fit the separate rod caps and their nuts.

chapters.title: Lower crankcase and oil sump
chapters.description: Fit the lower bearings and bedplate. Bench-build the oil sump, baffle and four screws, then install the complete unit on the inverted engine. Secure the sump, turn the engine upright and fit the flywheel.

chapters.title: Cylinder head and valves
chapters.description: Flip the loose head upside down and insert all 12 valves. Flip upright; build each stack: seat → seal → spring → retainer → two keepers. Install the complete head, then its bolts. F flips the active workpiece.

chapters.title: Camshafts and timing drive
chapters.description: Fit camshaft hubs, inner washers and hub bolts before outer pulleys. Install both inner shaft circlips, bench-build and install the timing idlers, then fit outer shaft clips and belt.

chapters.title: Head cover and fuel system
chapters.description: Complete each priority group, then continue to the next chapter.

chapters.title: Turbocharger and exhaust
chapters.description: Complete each priority group, then continue to the next chapter.

chapters.title: Intake and external plumbing
chapters.description: Complete each priority group, then continue to the next chapter.

chapters.title: Accessories and motor
chapters.description: Fit the upper bracket before the lower bracket. Fit the idler shaft inner circlip, completed idler and outer circlip in sequence. Mount the motor and fit the drive belt.
